title: MSFS 2024 Marketplace drop: 737 MAX commercial routes & weird places discovery!
description:
Ready to explore two completely different flight styles in Microsoft Flight Simulator 2024? Today we're diving into the newest marketplace drop featuring a patriotic narrow-body airliner package from Perfect Flight alongside a massive six-part visual discovery series from Koshi.

Whether you want to command scheduled commercial 737 routes across high-density corridors or hunt for strange landscape phenomena and bizarre world landmarks from above, we break down both add-ons to help you decide where to fly next:

✈️ COMMERCIAL OPERATIONS: AMERICA 250 (BOEING 737 MAX)
First, we look at the America 250 series expansion from Perfect Flight. Built specifically for the Boeing 737 MAX in MSFS 2024, this package celebrates the 4th of July / America 250 milestone with 12 liveries, authentic custom aviation soundsets, a dedicated in-sim mini-browser/briefing hub, and compatibility with third-party add-ons across realistic airline corridors.

🧭 SCENIC EXPLORATION & VFR DISCOVERY: KOSHI UNIQUE PLACES (PARTS 11–16)
Next, we throttle back and take a bush plane out for the long-awaited return of Koshi's Unique Places series (Parts 11 through 16). From spotting bizarre desert anomalies and Red Valley formations to remote cemeteries, giant staircases, and hidden airstrips across Nevada, Pennsylvania, California, Kansas, and Australia—this visual series is built for pilots who love hunting unique Earth curiosities. 

💡 Buyer's Tip: If you're eyeing the Koshi packs, consider whether to pick your favorite region now or wait for a potential discounted bundle down the line!

Which style are you flying first in MSFS 2024? Managing the flight deck of the 737 MAX on commercial routes, or hunting bizarre geological curiosities low and slow? Let us know in the comments below!
